summary: Learn maintenance planning and scheduling with CMMS, KPIs, job plans, and weekly schedules. Build practical tools you can use immediately.
lede: Maintenance planning and scheduling turns work orders into feasible, resource-aware jobs and schedules. The training is for maintenance, reliability, and operations professionals who prepare work and coordinate crews. Participants practice building job plans with labor and materials, creating weekly schedules around resource constraints, and using CMMS data and KPIs such as schedule compliance, MTBF, and MTTR to track performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who already work in maintenance operations and need a more disciplined way to plan, schedule, and report maintenance work. It fits the daily realities of maintenance, reliability, operations, and CMMS-based coordination.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and be prepared to work with sample work orders, backlog lists, and maintenance KPI data. If available, bring recent CMMS exports, shutdown calendars, or maintenance reports from your own operation for use in exercises.
